beats.say: The numbers are wrong. And now it is your problem.
Even when another team caused it. At senior level, you own the trust in the data.
beats.label: At senior level
beats.head: You own the trust

beats.say: Three steps: prevent with contracts, detect with tests, and recover from incidents.
beats.label: Track 14 · Data quality

check.prompt: A producer wants to rename a column that your pipeline reads. What does a data contract make them do?
options: Tell the consumers and version the change
check.why: The contract is a promise on the schema. A breaking change needs a new version.

beats.say: A data contract is a promise from the producer. These columns, these types, this freshness.
beats.label: Data contract
beats.head: A promise from the producer

beats.say: To add an optional column is safe. To rename or remove one breaks consumers.
beats.label: Schema changes
beats.head: Add is safe. Rename breaks.

beats.say: So a breaking change gets a new version, and a warning to the consumers.
beats.label: The rule
beats.head: Breaking change, new version

check.prompt: In write-audit-publish, when do users see the new data?
check.why: Write to a staging place, audit it, and publish only when the checks pass.

beats.say: Second: detect it before users do.
Write the new data to a staging place. Audit it with checks. Publish only if they pass.
beats.label: Write, audit, publish

beats.say: So bad data never reaches a dashboard. The old, good data stays in place.
beats.label: The result
beats.head: Bad data never reaches users

beats.say: Third: what does healthy data mean?
Watch four things: freshness, volume, schema, and the values themselves.
beats.label: Four signals

beats.say: Then set a target that users feel. For example: ready by seven, on 99 days of 100.
beats.label: SLO
beats.head: A target that users feel

beats.say: Last: the bad data is already out.
First contain it. Then fix the cause. Then backfill. Then write down what you learned.
beats.label: In this order

beats.say: Tell the users early. Silence costs more trust than the bug.
beats.label: Communication
beats.head: Tell users early

beats.say: Contracts prevent. Write, audit, publish detects. And contain an incident before you fix it.
beats.label: Data quality

beats.say: Now start the first lesson below.
